research.facts:
Curry Extension — Warriors Camp Opens With No Deal
**Verified Facts (HIGH):**
- Curry is in the final season of his current Warriors contract, earning $65M for 2026-27
- He became eligible for an extension in late August 2026
- Extension max: 2 years / $136.7 million (Over-38 Rule limits to 2 years max)
- Warriors publicly stated they will give Curry "whatever he wants"
- Some reports suggest Curry may take a discount to help Warriors land another star
- No deal signed as of Sept. 21, 2026
- Warriors hold their 2026 training camp at BYU-Hawaii, opening Sept. 29
- Teams with overseas preseason (Mavericks, Rockets) open Sept. 22; all others Sept. 29
**Sources:** CBS Sports, Bleacher Report, ESPN NBA Buzz tracker

research.facts:
Duren Qualifying Offer Deadline — Oct. 1
**Verified Facts (HIGH):**
- Oct. 1 is the deadline for restricted free agents to accept qualifying offers
- Duren's QO value: $9.6 million
- Detroit's reported offer: approximately $35M/year
- Duren reportedly seeking approximately $40M/year
- Duren earned third-team All-NBA honors in 2025-26
- Pistons finished atop the Eastern Conference standings with 60 wins in 2025-26
- Hard final deadline for QO acceptance: March 1, 2027
- If Duren accepts QO, he becomes unrestricted free agent next summer
- Report: Duren "increasingly prepared" to play on QO if no deal by end of September
**Sources:** CBS Sports, ClutchPoints, Eastern Herald, LastWordOnBasketball
